reference.description: Observed Dell 01.18.0005 image, not physical flash size or a native image capacity

principles: Build a native ARM7TDMI embedded NMC application, not a Linux distribution
Keep the existing UI unchanged and serve its assets only after hardware storage is proven
Prefer bounded preallocated buffers and streaming JSON, not heap-heavy frameworks
Reserve bootloader, recovery and configuration flash regions before setting production limits
Never confuse a 1,517,029-byte Dell update image with installed flash capacity
Never release from provisional size budgets; an installed flash/RAM layout is mandatory
